news.title: Valor Estate Limited (BSE:533160) agreed to acquire an additional minority stake in Bamboo Hotel and Global Centre (Delhi) Private Limited from Advent Hotels International Limited (NSEI:ADVENTHTL) for INR 5.97 billion.
news.body:
Valor Estate Limited (BSE:533160) agreed to acquire an additional minority stake in Bamboo Hotel and Global Centre (Delhi) Private Limited from Advent Hotels International Limited (NSEI:ADVENTHTL) for INR 5.97 billion on March 5, 2026. A cash consideration INR 6028.54 per share will be paid by Valor Estate Limited. As part of consideration, INR 5.97 billion is paid towards 0.99 million Class A Shares common equity of Bamboo Hotel and Global Centre (Delhi) Private Limited.

The transaction is subject to approval of merger agreement by target board, approval of offer by acquirer shareholders, approval of offer by target shareholders and approval/consents of lenders/creditors.
